atoms.b: Yes, why is the city called ((++Uxmal Oxmol))?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+0.2st'>Yes, why is the city called Oozmarl?</prosody>

atoms.b: Uxmal means “thrice built”. The Maya believed in rebuilding their cities to please the ((++gods cows)).
atoms.sound: Uxmal means “thrice built”. The Maya believed in rebuilding their cities to please the ((++gods cows)).

atoms.b: Now, let’s go and see the biggest monument in Uxmal: the ((++Pyramid Triangle)) of the Magician!
atoms.sound: Now, let’s go and see the biggest monument in Uxmal: the Pyramid of the Magician!

instruction.text: Build the picture of the Pyramid of the Magician.

atoms.b: This is the Pyramid of the ((++Magician Great)). It is most famous for its oval shape.
atoms.sound: ssml: This is the Pyramid of the Magician. It is most famous for its oval <phoneme alphabet='ipa' ph=' ʃɛ́jp'>shape</phoneme>.

atoms.b: The building of the Pyramid can be explained with a ((++Maya Greek)) legend.
atoms.sound: ssml: The bilding of the Pyramid can be explaynd with a Maya <phoneme alphabet='ipa' ph='ˈlɛdʒ(ə)nd'>legend</phoneme>.

instruction.text: Read the legend and answer the questions.

atoms.text: There was once a hut where the Pyramid of the Magician now stands.
Inside the hut lived an old woman who didn’t have any children. Many people said she was a witch.
One day, she decided she really wanted a child, so she enchanted an egg. After many days, her son hatched out of the egg.
Her son, given the name Itzamná, decided to build a pyramid using his magical powers. This is now known as the Pyramid of the Magician.

hint.label: Itzamná
hint.text: Itzamná became one of the most important gods in Maya civilisation.

atoms.a: What structure existed before the building of the Pyramid?

finish.text: The House of the Turtles in Uxmal is decorated with turtle statues. It is thought to have been a place where the Maya worshipped water.
finish.sound: The House of the Turtles in Oozmarl is decorated with turtle statues. It is thought to have been a place where the Maya worshipped water.

atoms.b: The last stop on our tour is the famous ball court.
atoms.sound: ssml: The last stop on  <phoneme alphabet='ipa' ph='ˈaʊə'>our</phoneme> tour is the famous ball court.

atoms.b: It was used to play a ((++game song)) that the Maya invented called pitz.
atoms.sound: ssml: It was yused to play a game that the Maya invented caled pitz

atoms.b: Pitz is a team game played to resolve conflicts. It was used as an alternative to ((++war tennis)).
atoms.sound: ssml: Pitz is a teem game <phoneme alphabet='ipa' ph='pleɪd'>played</phoneme> to resolve conflicts. It was <phoneme alphabet='ipa' ph='juːzd'>used</phoneme> as an alternativ to <phoneme alphabet='ipa' ph='wɔr'>war</phoneme>.

atoms.b: Wow! Thank you for the tour.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+0.2st'>Wow! Thank you for the tour.</prosody>
